decision_target: Current frozen gate into production candidate rejection
conclusion: No demonstrated false rejection of an established valid sacrifice. One materially cleaner23ply sacrifice control survives; a22ply poisoned-horse control also survives but its prior R3e loses454cp against R2d at100k, so it is not admitted as clean production-safety evidence. The user's rook sacrifice is refuted, and the pawn follow-up passes the narrow gate despite multiple strong defenses. Coverage/quality remains insufficient for production.

bishop_block_rook_sacrifice.compensation_or_refutation: 23.B*7g leaves rook2d attacked. Immediate Px2d allows Bx8f. Better R8h+ takes silver first; Bx8h Px2d Bx1a+ leaves sente with compensation. The100k pair is +1490 for Px2d versus +357 for R8h+:1133cp difference, not a full100k optimal gap.
bishop_block_rook_sacrifice.why_position_is_natural: Documented23ply 4-five-bishop sequence of pawn exchanges, bishop exchange, tempo pawn drop and rook attack/interposition. Unlike old17.B8h7g, this is a bishop DROP. No >300cp played-vs-root-best child loss found among the flagged prefix comparisons. Root20/21 swings remain substantial horizon-noise warnings; this is not exhaustive proof of naturalness.
bishop_block_rook_sacrifice.quality_limit: One opening family and shallow selective history audit; no measured reach or independent human naturalness verification.
bishop_block_rook_sacrifice.human_review_point: Check the full history, distinction from old17.B7g, why immediate rook capture permits Bx8f, and compensation after R8h+ Bx8h Px2d Bx1a+.

horse_entry_bad_gold_recapture.compensation_or_refutation: 22...B6g+ offers the horse. Gx6g permits R8h+ and further rook penetration. B*7g is a better defense.100k Gx6g=-585 versus B*7g=-130 gives455cp deficit for sente. This supports poison, not history quality.
horse_entry_bad_gold_recapture.why_position_is_natural: Published short side variation, but21.R3e is inferior to R2d by330cp at10k and454cp at100k. This is not the old repeated missed-rook sequence, yet it fails to provide an unambiguously clean starting control under the user's quality requirement.
horse_entry_bad_gold_recapture.quality_limit: Do not count survival as a second independent high-quality safety success. Expected should_keep was a prospective hypothesis, not ground truth.
horse_entry_bad_gold_recapture.human_review_point: Is R3e a plausible ordinary inaccuracy or a disqualifying missed tactic? Compare Gx6g with B*7g and inspect the rook invasion.

user_rook_counter_sacrifice.compensation_or_refutation: 19.R2b+ Sx2b stays -2484 at10k and -2478 at100k. Recapture is the best explicit10k response and frozen strong witness. No sufficient compensation was demonstrated; rejection is not a proven false negative.
user_rook_counter_sacrifice.why_position_is_natural: Not clean: old17.B7g evaluates -2477 at100k versus -30 for17.P*8g, a2447cp difference. User R8i+ line preserves this prior error rather than repairing it.
user_rook_counter_sacrifice.quality_limit: Original19.R2a+ alternative is illegal because bishop2b blocks the rook. A small engine shortlist finds B7g2b+ less bad than R2b+, not a demonstrated better practical surprise.
user_rook_counter_sacrifice.human_review_point: Compare17.P*8g with17.B7g; after R8i+ compare Bx2b+ and Rx2b+, then see why Sx2b refutes the proposed rook sacrifice.

user_pawn_drop_followup.compensation_or_refutation: 21.P*8b remains losing against R8i8b, N*8f, and S7a8b. At10k R8b and N8f tie at-2802; S8b=-2697. At100k the selected subset gives R8b=-2756,N8f=-2588,S8b=-2864. No uniquely necessary hidden knight reply. Manual rejection rests on these straightforward good defenses and absent demonstrated compensation, not candidate-root CP alone.
user_pawn_drop_followup.why_position_is_natural: Not clean: inherits17.B7g and19.R2b+ errors. Cannot supply valid-sacrifice safety evidence.
user_pawn_drop_followup.quality_limit: Frozen gate has0 strong witnesses here: pawn captures are not free-major captures or qualifying recaptures. not_falsified is therefore absence of this narrow trigger, NOT viability. Human choice probabilities were not measured.
user_pawn_drop_followup.human_review_point: Compare direct pawn captures with N*8f; inspect N*8f Bx8f Rx8f P8a+ Rx8a. Separate gate non-rejection from rejection of the current research hypothesis.
